text:
elaine: Heads-up: after the routing rollout this morning I see a short spike in SSE reconnects and a handful of duplicate billing markers. Not widespread but reproducible in canary.

diego: Which rollout? route-affinity change?

elaine: We trimmed idle stickiness (prune-after=45s) for eu-canary. Some clients saw a 204 midstream then reattached to a fallback route that uses the old quota key.

ravi: Console telemetry is useless here — resume-span sampling was at 0.5% during the rollout so we only have 2 traces. We should auto-bump sampling for 24h after any routing change.

sam: Quick repro: start SSE -> flip prune -> proxy returns 204 -> client reconnects -> server logs duplicate attach. Tiny script:```
curl -N "https://api.redwood/stream?c=test" &
sleep 1
curl -XPOST "https://console.internal/api/routes/prune?target=eu-canary"
kill -HUP $!
```

diego: Immediate mitigations: 1) revert prune-after to previous value for canary (fast), 2) implement proxy attach idempotency header (X-Attach-Nonce) so rapid retries dedupe server-side (safer long-term).

ravi: Also add a rollout annotation to the reconnect dashboard: when a route config change is applied, bubble that into the timeline overlay. We wasted time correlating timestamps manually.

elaine: Ops wants an alert rule: page if (resume_failures > 5/min) AND (duplicate_billing > 0) within same 60s window. Can someone add that?

sam: I'll push cfg-202407: routes.eu-canary.prune_after=300s + tracing.resume_sample=0.10. Rolling now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started config rollout cfg-202407 to eu-canary. Targets: 3 hosts. 1/3 updated.

diego: Filing follow-ups: RTE-212 normalize-fallback-quota-keys, RTE-213 proxy-attach-idempotency (X-Attach-Nonce), RTE-214 reconnect-dashboard-annotation, RTE-215 auto-sample-after-rollout.

ravi: After the rollback + sample bump duplicate markers dropped ~95% within 90s. Leaving sampling at 10% for 8h to collect better traces.

elaine: Incident note saved. Minimal user impact but billing dupes unacceptable. Will follow up with a short postmortem and a console UX mock for the annotation. :thumbsup:
